observations: Photo 0: A disassembled car engine sitting on a paved/tiled outdoor surface, with a person sitting on an orange plastic chair in the background.
Photo 0 and 1: Valve cover embossed with the word 'PORSCHE' in capital letters.
Photo 1: Close-up of the intake manifold and valve cover, showing oil residue and grime around the oil cap and gasket areas.
Photo 2: Another angle of the same engine, showing wiring harness connectors, a sensor housing, and hoses, some disconnected or dangling.
No visible engine code, serial number plate, or VIN sticker in any photo.
No stand, engine hoist, or test rig visible; engine appears to be resting directly on the ground.
Watermark across all photos reads 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS', seller's own branding, not a verification mark.
Wiring harness connectors appear loose or cut in places (photo 1, photo 2), suggesting the engine has been pulled from a donor vehicle.

identity.kind: used Porsche engine (exact model/engine code not legible)

claims.claim: We also deals in all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: General business claim, no photo evidence of inventory range or legitimacy of operation.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal damage (no start-up test shown).
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine running or turning over on a test stand.

risks.risk: Exact engine model/displacement cannot be confirmed, which strongly affects value (different Porsche engines vary widely in price).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code/serial plate or casting number stamped on the block.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced until model is confirmed

risks.risk: Engine could be incomplete (missing turbo, sensors, ECU, or wiring harness sections visible as cut/loose).
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photos showing all connectors intact and a parts inventory list.

risks.risk: Engine sitting directly on ground raises risk of contamination (dirt, water ingress) into open ports.
risks.proof: Close-up of intake/exhaust ports showing covers or plugs in place.

risks.risk: Mileage and history (accident, flood, or fire damage) of the donor vehicle unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of donor vehicle or any accompanying paperwork/logbook.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown history, worst case

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code/serial number plate or stamped casting number on the block.
Video of the engine cranking or running to demonstrate function.
Photos showing all open ports (intake, exhaust, oil) covered or plugged to confirm no contamination.
Photo of any accompanying documentation (purchase invoice, donor vehicle registration) to confirm sourcing.
response.reason: The photos confirm this is a Porsche-branded engine but do not show the specific engine code or model, which is the key detail that sets the price range for a Porsche engine; without it, even a worst-case price cannot be assigned.
